title: General.
officialText:
Steel structures shall be designed to meet all of the requirements of this section. However, details provided for
gravity, seismic and wind forces and for other purposes may be regarded as forming part of, or the whole of, these requirements.
Detailing provided for one requirement may be counted towards the other requirements.
Exceptions:
1. One-story structures less than 5,000 square feet (465 m2) not to exceed 15 feet (4572 mm) in height.
2. Structures in Group R-3 occupancy not more than three stories in height.
